label: inconclusive
labelReason: Run-7 metalness scalar vs map (pre-registered, METALMAP handoff): shell-metal1-mapkept=pass, shell-metal05-mapnull=pass, shell-metal1 anchor=pass -> metal1-mapkept passes and metal1 passes: scalar metalness=1 sufficient; nulling the map was unnecessary (proposed); metal05-mapnull passes: removing the map alone (at 0.5) is enough (proposed). Run-6 one-factor splits (pre-registered, FACTORS handoff): shell-rough0=fail, shell-metal1=pass -> metal1 clears, rough0 fails: metalness path dominates (proposed). Run-5 shell-sens fixture (shell mesh + metalness 1/roughness 0/maps removed) met the pre-registered criterion (automated.shellSens.automatedChannelCheck=pass); run-4 plane sensitivity=pass; authored-shell synthetic=fail preserved (run-3 fail in history); asset=fail (post-hoc metric). Awaiting named human review (required for pass).

limitations: Environment is Three.js RoomEnvironment (procedural, fixed), not a pinned HDRI file; fixture lighting is deterministic but not the HDRI the trial contract names.
Pixel-difference metric (shell-masked) is mean absolute 8-bit sRGB difference after ACES tone mapping; it shows an effect exists, not that it is correct.
RGBA8 readback cannot detect NaN directly; visible NaN/flicker review is part of the human protocol.
Rendered by software rasterizer in headless Chrome; hardware GPUs may differ.
Thickness range used is the asset-authored 600–800 nm; the lab record default [100,400] is preserved as an unresolved conflict (C-07).
nonClaims: KHR_materials_iridescence conformance of any WebGL2 proxy
